# Every cancel of a job held because its upload Begin or its submit is in
# doubt reports the hold with exit 5, the second and a reopened one too,
# and the job directory alone decides it: no EC2 call, no session, no
# Begin, no submit, and the same status. A job never submitted and with
# no upload ends at every cancel with exit 0.

skygo-ec2 start -config $CONFIG -state $STATE -credentials $CREDS -interval 0
code 0

# An upload Begin whose reply was lost holds the run.
lose BeginArtifactUpload 1
! job run -job $WORK/begin -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 5
stdout '"hold": "upload-begin-outcome-unknown"'
opens 1
accepted BeginArtifactUpload 1
rawmark BeginArtifactUpload

ec2mark
! job cancel -job $WORK/begin
code 5
stdout '"desired": "cancel"'
stdout '"state": "NEVER_SUBMITTED"'
stdout '"hold": "upload-begin-outcome-unknown"'
cp stdout $WORK/begin-first.json
! job cancel -job $WORK/begin
code 5
cmp stdout $WORK/begin-first.json
! job cancel -job $WORK/begin
code 5
cmp stdout $WORK/begin-first.json
! job resume -job $WORK/begin
code 5
stdout '"hold": "upload-begin-outcome-unknown"'
ec2since 0
opens 1
accepted BeginArtifactUpload 1
rawsince BeginArtifactUpload 0
calls CancelArtifactUpload 0
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 0
jobs 0

# A submit whose reply was lost (the server applied it) is held by the
# first cancel, and by every later one.
lose SubmitWorkspaceJob 1
! job run -job $WORK/doubt -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
stdout '"submit": "sent"'
opens 2
ec2mark
! job cancel -job $WORK/doubt
code 5
stdout '"hold": "canceled-with-submit-outcome-unknown"'
cp stdout $WORK/doubt-first.json
! job cancel -job $WORK/doubt
code 5
cmp stdout $WORK/doubt-first.json
ec2since 0
opens 2
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 1
calls CancelJob 0
jobs 1

# The twin: a job whose session never opened was never submitted and has
# no upload. Every cancel ends it, without a hold or a remote request.
openfail
! job run -job $WORK/never -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
opens 3
ec2mark
job cancel -job $WORK/never
code 0
stdout '"state": "NEVER_SUBMITTED"'
! stdout '"hold"'
job cancel -job $WORK/never
code 0
! stdout '"hold"'
ec2since 0
opens 3
accepted BeginArtifactUpload 2
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 1

mutations 1

-- task.json --
{"argv":["/bin/true"],"timeoutSeconds":"60"}
-- src/input.txt --
input
